title: Nutmeg crunchy Algerian pineapple Tagine
description: A spicy and indulgent Algerian dish featuring pineapple chunks, this tagine is a perfect blend of crunchy and low-sodium-friendly flavors. It is made with dry brine and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pineapple chunks, chicken broth, and sliced almonds, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the pineapple is tender and the liquid has thickened.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot over couscous or rice.
Garnish with additional sliced almonds and a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.
